deterministic path (AI_SYSTEM.md §7's NO_AI fallback: 'country names and demonyms
Search-assist data, NOT catalogue data. A wrong entry degrades one query; it cannot
reach an opportunity record. The ISO codes are still validated against the countries
table at runtime, so a code that is wrong here matches nothing rather than inventing
Kept as data rather than derived by suffix rules, because the rules do not hold:
Madagascar gives Malagasy, Lesotho gives Basotho and Mosotho, Botswana gives
Batswana and Motswana, Niger gives Nigerien which is a different country from Nigeria's
Nigerian. A suffix heuristic would confuse exactly the pair where confusion matters.
